tool.name: ParaFEM Box Mesh Generator
tool.description: Generate a structured hexahedral box mesh using p12meshgen
tool.command:
NELS=\$(( $nxe * $nye * $nze )) && AA=\$(awk "BEGIN {printf "%.8f", $dim_x / $nxe}") && BB=\$(awk "BEGIN {printf "%.8f", $dim_y / $nye}") && CC=\$(awk "BEGIN {printf "%.8f", $dim_z / $nze}") && printf "'p123'
'parafem' %s $nxe $nze 8
%s %s %s 1.0 1.0 1.0
1.0e-6 2000
0 0
" "\${NELS}" "\${AA}" "\${BB}" "\${CC}" > job.mg && p12meshgen job && mv job.d '$output_d' && mv job.bnd '$output_bnd'

param.name: nxe
param.label: Elements in X
param.help: Number of elements along the X axis (length)

param.name: nye
param.label: Elements in Y
param.help: Number of elements along the Y axis (width)

param.name: nze
param.label: Elements in Z
param.help: Number of elements along the Z axis (height)

param.name: dim_x
param.label: X dimension (m)
param.help: Total mesh dimension in X direction (metres)

param.name: dim_y
param.label: Y dimension (m)
param.help: Total mesh dimension in Y direction (metres)

param.name: dim_z
param.label: Z dimension (m)
param.help: Total mesh dimension in Z direction (metres)

tool.help:
Generates a structured 8-node hexahedral box mesh for ParaFEM using p12meshgen.
The mesh is a rectangular box with uniform element sizes. Output files: - .d file: nodal coordinates and element connectivity - .bnd file: boundary node restraints (all surface nodes)
Coordinate convention: X spans [0, dim_x], Y spans [0, dim_y], Z spans [-dim_z, 0] (negative, per ParaFEM convention). The downstream BC generator handles this automatically.
The .bnd file restrains ALL boundary nodes. The BC generator tool downstream will selectively keep only the nodes that need prescribed values.
